definitions: To reaffirm or repeat a promise or commitment, especially one made previously in a formal or sacred context.
To reiterate marital promises, often in a ceremony celebrating a significant anniversary.
examples: They decided to renew their vows on their tenth anniversary.
After overcoming challenges, the couple chose to renew their vows as a symbol of their enduring love.
Many couples renew their vows to celebrate milestones in their marriage.
